name: End-to-End Warranty Returns & RMA Resolution Management

parameters.content:
## End-to-End Warranty Returns & RMA Resolution Management

### How it works
Validates an RMA request, checks order/product/warranty data, classifies the issue with AI, routes approval, manages return monitoring and inspection, then closes the case as refund, replacement, repair, or rejection.

### Setup
- Connect Google Sheets and provide the configured document ID.
- Connect Gmail for customer and reviewer notifications.
- Connect OpenAI for issue classification.
- Set reviewer/test emails and business thresholds in Configuration.

### Customize
Adjust warranty rules, return windows, approval limits, risk thresholds, deadlines, reviewer routing, and supported resolution paths.

## Capture RMA intake

Collects the request, applies configuration, normalizes fields, and creates the case ID.

## Check required fields

Confirms all mandatory request fields are present.

## Validate order record

Looks up the order and confirms it exists.

## Verify customer identity

Checks that the submitted customer matches the order.

## Validate product serial

Confirms the product and required serial match the order.

## Check duplicate RMA

Blocks an open duplicate RMA for the same order and product.

## Evaluate warranty status

Calculates warranty expiry and validates warranty eligibility.

## Check claim window

Validates the return window and required evidence.

## Classify issue eligibility

Uses OpenAI to classify the issue and checks supported categories.

## Score claim risk

Calculates claim value, risk score, and manual-review need.

## Request manual approval

Sends the review package and waits for the reviewer decision.

## Select initial resolution

Combines approval results and routes refund, replacement, or repair.

## Reserve replacement stock

Checks availability and reserves stock for replacement cases.

## Authorize repair path

Prepares the repair authorization for approved repair cases.

## Validate refund path

Checks the requested refund amount before authorization.

## Create RMA authorization

Creates the RMA, saves it, notifies the customer, and logs authorization.

## Poll return status

Waits, reads the current RMA status, and checks whether the item returned.

## Send return reminder

Sends and logs a return reminder when the deadline condition is met.

## Escalate overdue return

Marks overdue returns, sends escalation, and logs the notice.

## Start return inspection

Starts inspection and requests the reviewer decision.

## Record inspection outcome

Records whether inspection was approved or rejected.

## Record final resolution

Closes approved cases as refund, replacement, or repair and updates inventory.

## Notify final decision

Sends the final customer decision and logs the notification.

parameters.formDescription: Submit your product warranty, return, repair, replacement, or refund request. Please provide accurate order and product information.

conditions.leftValue: ={{   !!$json.productSku &&   String($json.productStatus || '').toLowerCase() === 'active' &&   $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.productSku === $('Read Order from Sheets').item.json.productSku &&   (     String($json.requiresSerial || '').toLowerCase() !== 'true' ||     (       !!$('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.serialNumber &&       $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.serialNumber === $('Read Order from Sheets').item.json.serialNumber     )   ) }}

assignments.name: appliedWarrantyMonths
assignments.value: ={{ Number($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.warrantyMonths || $('Set Configuration Parameters').item.json.defaultWarrantyMonths) }}

assignments.name: warrantyExpiryDate
assignments.value: ={{ DateTime.fromISO($('Read Order from Sheets').item.json.purchaseDate).plus({ months: Number($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.warrantyMonths || $('Set Configuration Parameters').item.json.defaultWarrantyMonths) }).toISODate() }}

assignments.name: warrantyActive
assignments.value: ={{ $now.startOf('day') <= DateTime.fromISO($('Read Order from Sheets').item.json.purchaseDate).plus({ months: Number($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.warrantyMonths || $('Set Configuration Parameters').item.json.defaultWarrantyMonths) }).endOf('day') }}

assignments.name: returnWindowExpiryDate
assignments.value: ={{ DateTime.fromISO($('Read Order from Sheets').item.json.purchaseDate).plus({ days: Number($('Set Configuration Parameters').item.json.standardReturnWindowDays) }).toISODate() }}

values.content:
=You are an RMA issue classification assistant.

Analyze product issues for warranty and return processing.

Return ONLY valid JSON in exactly this structure:

{
  "issueCategory": "",
  "issueSubcategory": "",
  "probableCause": "",
  "issueSummary": "",
  "confidenceScore": 0,
  "manualReviewRecommended": false
}

Allowed issueCategory values:
- Manufacturing Defect
- Shipping Damage
- Wrong Product
- Missing Part
- Performance Issue
- Cosmetic Damage
- Accidental Damage
- Unknown

Rules:
- confidenceScore must be a number from 0 to 100.
- Do not approve or reject a warranty or return claim.
- Do not decide eligibility.
- Do not invent facts not provided by the customer.
- Use "Unknown" if the information is insufficient.
- Set manualReviewRecommended to true if confidenceScore is below 70 or the issue is ambiguous.
- Return JSON only. Do not include markdown or explanations.

assignments.name: standardIssueCategory
assignments.value: ={{ [   'Manufacturing Defect',   'Shipping Damage',   'Wrong Product',   'Missing Part',   'Performance Issue',   'Cosmetic Damage',   'Accidental Damage',   'Unknown' ].includes($json.output[0].content[0].text.issueCategory)   ? $json.output[0].content[0].text.issueCategory   : 'Unknown' }}

assignments.name: claimExceedsAutoLimit
assignments.value: ={{   Number($('Read Order from Sheets').item.json.productPrice)   >   Number($('Set Configuration Parameters').item.json.autoApprovalLimit) }}

assignments.name: riskScore
assignments.value: ={{   ($json.claimExceedsAutoLimit === true ? 40 : 0)   +   ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.manualReviewRecommended === true ? 30 : 0)   +   ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.confidenceScore < 70 ? 20 : 0)   +   ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.standardIssueCategory === 'Unknown' ? 25 : 0) }}

assignments.name: riskLevel
assignments.value: ={{   (     ($json.claimExceedsAutoLimit === true ? 40 : 0)     +     ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.manualReviewRecommended === true ? 30 : 0)     +     ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.confidenceScore < 70 ? 20 : 0)     +     ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.standardIssueCategory === 'Unknown' ? 25 : 0)   ) >= Number($('Set Configuration Parameters').item.json.highRiskThreshold)     ? 'High'     :   (     ($json.claimExceedsAutoLimit === true ? 40 : 0)     +     ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.manualReviewRecommended === true ? 30 : 0)     +     ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.confidenceScore < 70 ? 20 : 0)     +     ($('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.standardIssueCategory === 'Unknown' ? 25 : 0)   ) >= 35     ? 'Medium'     : 'Low' }}

assignments.name: riskReason
assignments.value: ={{   $json.claimExceedsAutoLimit === true     ? 'Claim value exceeds automatic approval limit'     : $('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.manualReviewRecommended === true       ? 'AI classification recommends manual review'       : $('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.confidenceScore < 70         ? 'Low classification confidence'         : 'No elevated risk indicators' }}

assignments.name: approvalSummary
assignments.value: =Case ID: {{ $('Create Case ID').item.json.caseId }} Customer: {{ $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.customerName }} Product: {{ $('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.productName }} Issue: {{ $('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.issueSummary }} Category: {{ $('Categorize Issue Details').item.json.standardIssueCategory }} Requested Resolution: {{ $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution }} Claim Value: {{ $('Assess Claim Value').item.json.claimCurrency }} {{ $('Assess Claim Value').item.json.claimValue }} Risk Level: {{ $('Analyze Risk Level').item.json.riskLevel }} Risk Reason: {{ $('Analyze Risk Level').item.json.riskReason }}

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.approvalSubject }}

assignments.name: resolutionType
assignments.value: ={{   $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution === 'Replacement'   && String($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.replacementEligible).toLowerCase() === 'true'     ? 'Replacement'     : $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution === 'Repair'       && String($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.repairEligible).toLowerCase() === 'true'         ? 'Repair'         : $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution === 'Refund'           ? 'Refund'           : 'Manual Resolution Review' }}

assignments.name: resolutionReason
assignments.value: ={{   $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution === 'Replacement'   && String($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.replacementEligible).toLowerCase() === 'true'     ? 'Replacement requested and product is replacement eligible'     : $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution === 'Repair'       && String($('Read Product Record from Sheets').item.json.repairEligible).toLowerCase() === 'true'         ? 'Repair requested and product is repair eligible'         : $('Normalize RMA Data').item.json.requestedResolution === 'Refund'           ? 'Refund requested by customer'           : 'Requested resolution is not directly available' }}

parameters.message:
=

Hello {{ $json.customerName }},

Your RMA request has been approved.

RMA Number: {{ $json.rmaNumber }}
Order ID: {{ $json.orderId }}
Product SKU: {{ $json.productSku }}
Resolution: {{ $json.resolutionType }}
Status: {{ $json.rmaStatus }}
Return Deadline: {{ DateTime.fromISO($json.returnDeadline).toFormat('dd LLL yyyy') }}

Please return the product before the return deadline and clearly mention your RMA number with the shipment.

{{ $json.resolutionType === 'Refund' ? 'Your refund will proceed after the returned product is received and successfully inspected.' : $json.resolutionType === 'Replacement' ? 'Your replacement will proceed after the returned product is received and successfully inspected.' : $json.resolutionType === 'Repair' ? 'Your repair process will begin after the returned product is received and inspected.' : 'Your approved resolution will proceed after the returned product is received and inspected.' }}

Please keep your RMA number for future reference regarding this case.

Regards,
RMA Support Team
